# IP-05 Final Audit — CR-012 / FEAT34

**Verdict: PASS**

`docs/implementation-plan.md` v0.2.0b resolves all three prior Major findings. It is complete and internally consistent as a **conditional planning artifact** while the preflight, MSP, contract, runtime, and release gates remain open. This PASS approves neither implementation nor any Phase 2 promotion, schema/code/generated change, deployment, runtime admission, delivery, canary, or release.

## Audit history

| Review | Verdict | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Initial IP-05 audit | NEEDS REVISION | H3 was absent from the configuration topology; the AO-02 release path conflicted with authoritative VO-FE-05 → VO-FE-06; traceability and implementation-plan dependency/mechanism inventories were incomplete. |
| Fix-cycle re-audit | PASS | Plan v0.2.0b resolves all three Major findings and preserves all prior PASS gates. |

## Prior Major finding verification

### Major 1 — H3 configuration topology: PASS

- The DAG makes `DEC-01 → H3`, then H3 a predecessor of both BE-02 and BE-03 before their convergence with executed VER-01 at H8 (`docs/implementation-plan.md:218-250`).
- The configuration-path prose repeats the H3 join and H3-backed H8 evidence (`:253-271`).
- The gate ledger defines H3 canonical binding and makes H8 consume H3-backed BE-02/03 evidence (`:306-322`).
- S5, S6, and M2 independently repeat the same entry/acceptance condition (`:377-413`).
- AO-01 remains buildable as a non-binding shell, so H3 does not over-block safe static work.

No dependency cycle is introduced. A missing, stale, revoked, or unproven CR-004 binding remains an empty/unavailable picker with no arbitrary identifier or runtime action.

### Major 2 — authoritative VO-FE-05 / AO-02 topology: PASS

- The plan explicitly retains the Boss-approved frontend execution plan as authority and supplies an implementation-to-VO-FE crosswalk (`docs/implementation-plan.md:286-304`).
- AO-01 is only the static subset; AO-02 is the governed-binding subset that completes combined VO-FE-05. VO-FE-05 precedes VO-FE-06/FE-02 and REL-01 (`:291-302`).
- `VO-TOP-001` expressly rejects the former non-blocking AO-02 option. Any static-only release now requires a separately approved amendment to the frontend authority (`:301-304`).
- The DAG, blockers, roadmap, milestone, and REL-01 DoD all enforce that same decision (`:237-243`, `:265-271`, `:324-353`, `:391-413`, `:562-570`).

The final plan therefore complements rather than silently supersedes `docs/design/visual-office-frontend-execution-plan.md`.

### Major 3 — bidirectional traceability and inventories: PASS

- Exact source-to-plan coverage maps all eight IP-01 authoritative inputs by path, source sections/nodes, plan sections, and IP-REQ ranges (`docs/implementation-plan.md:60-75`).
- All 19 functional requirements map forward to exact source authority, packages/windows, stable evidence IDs, and gates (`:501-523`).
- Eight stable `NFR-VO-001..008` definitions cover tenancy, RBAC, PII/secrets, audit/concurrency, fail-closed availability, performance/freshness, accessibility, and no-deception (`:142-153`); all eight map forward to source, package/window, evidence, and gate (`:525-536`).
- Thirteen stable `EV-*` evidence sets identify their consuming gates/releases (`:483-499`). Every evidence ID is consumed by at least one forward or reverse trace row.
- The reverse matrix covers all 19 accepted packages and maps each back to IP-REQ/NFR closure, stable evidence, gate, and window (`:538-560`).
- The third-party/infrastructure inventory distinguishes existing, proposed, later, and unresolved dependencies without claiming deployment (`:113-124`).
- The mechanism inventory distinguishes server invariants, RBAC/source gates, policy gates, kill switches, human release gates, and unresolved feature-flag decisions without inventing flag names (`:341-353`).
